versions.changelog: Step 11 now prepares publish package and logs D-## approval request — does NOT execute publish. Step 11.5 is the actual publish execution, gated on explicit D-## yes. ClawhHub publish is now a hard-gated external action.
Step 11 now extracts slug/name/version from skill.yml instead of guessing. Step 11.5 adds post-publish verification via clawhub inspect. display_name field now required in skill.yml.
Added missing scripts: validate-structure.sh, validate-release-content.sh, opsec-scan.sh. Standalone installs now fully functional.
Two-phase automation model: Phase 1 auto → user gate → Phase 2 auto. Minimal intervention.
Fix hardcoded org name in Step 3 examples — resolved OPSEC flag
Browser-based security scan verification, declared permissions, scan remediation guidance
Full ClawhHub publication pipeline with auto-scaffolding, OPSEC scanning, dual review, and force-push release
